create(input)
revise(baseId, edit) --> prepareEdit; unchanged -> reuse base

issue(prepared, base?) -> diagramRevisions.register
revision: id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs
node correspondence -> preserve nodeRefs; new nodes -> UUID

getRevision(id) / listRevisions(diagramId) -> registry reads
generate(request, options) -> DiagramGenerator.generate
agentContext?, instruction, input, baseRevisionId?, selection context
abort checks + base identity check -> revise(replace) OR create
